n: Monk Makes Electronics Kit for Pico
t: A low-cost kit with ten projects for learning electronics with a Raspberry Pi Pico.
steps: Buy the kit from a retailer such as Pimoroni or RobotShop.
Buy a Raspberry Pi Pico for each kit.
Solder the headers or buy a Pico with headers already soldered.
Install a tool such as Thonny to program the Pico.
Build the first project on the custom breadboard.
Work through the ten projects in order.
